noun_definition: iou thread refers to the series of messages and interactions related to an IOU (I Owe You) transaction that can be accessed through a direct message and subsequently viewed in an IOU report and details page.
details page refers to the specific interface within the IOU report that displays detailed information about a money request, which is expected to have the same opacity as the IOU report page.
Shade of gray refers to the level of opacity applied to the content in the IOU report and details page, which is expected to be 50% but is incorrectly rendered at 25% when created offline.
